t: Emperor Sigismund made Savoy a duchy in 1416, joining French-speaking Alpine lands with Italian-speaking Piedmont.
Restored in 1559 after French occupation, it moved its capital to Turin and became a disciplined absolutist military state.
Its dukes became kings of Sicily and then Sardinia, and their kingdom later united Italy; Savoy itself passed to France in 1860.
dyk: Amadeus VIII, the first Duke of Savoy, retired to a lakeside priory and was then elected antipope as Felix V by the Council of Basel in 1439.
